name: 38138 · Germantown, TN
findings: ZIP 38138 (Germantown) has 192 nonprofit organizations. 74 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 56 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 38138 (Germantown) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 11 education organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
